items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: With a carnival. Jim Kelly... He took me cutting his legs off. Took me apart.

ctx.x: Jim Kelly, yeah. Chambon. That was Ernest Kelly's anchor. We didn't know Ernest Kelly. Didn't have his name either. Yeah, I have his name. He's a trauma. Chambon, yeah. Dead fish brother. He had diabetes. He took me cutting his legs off. Took me apart.
